provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair snippets/price-format.liquid. product.price is a nonnegative integer number of cents. Output one span class=price with text $D.CC: D is the whole-dollar amount as a base-10 integer with no separators, and CC is exactly two digits of remaining cents. Do not use Shopify money filters. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/price-format.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
